extra.reason: Implemented: SQLite ingest with arc translation, in-process denominator, fail-loudly schema and context checks. Verified byte-identical to coverage json; 76 tests pass; ruff/ty clean.

Fixed by recording failed setup/teardown-phase reports in the pytest hook, so setup-erroring tests get an outcome entry instead of leaving an orphaned coverage context. Added regression coverage in tests/test_e2e.py.
Added per-test files_covered and top-level measured_files to the profile
Fixed as part of so-u3i; boolean flags now emit only their positive form and tests cover both the present and absent cases.

xdist supported: per-worker outcomes files merged by the runner, worker count recorded in the profile, time-based optimiser errors on a parallel profile with an --allow-parallel-durations override. Verified end to end with real pytest-xdist: 93/93 tests captured across 2 workers.

Import graph captured into the profile. Three-part graph (edges, unattributed_modules, resolution_errors) built from wrapping builtins.__import__ and importlib.import_module. Verified serial and under 3 xdist workers: identical 91-edge graph, all acceptance criteria covered by tests.

Superseded by so-n6b, which now carries this spec verbatim as its description, design and notes. Its children moved up to so-n6b: grouping by hierarchy was not carrying information, and the axis that matters is the touched-files-mvp label.
